body:
Founder real-time: co-op ally NPC (Alyx Vance register) -- scientist at a local government energy agency, secretly founder of a wholesome hacktivist guild (the Uncompromised). Independently found the Amon/Beleth/Vassago/Zagan/Stolas frequency table through his own compliance data, years before The Field went public. Kept deliberately out of README.md SIV's Faction Dossiers, matching the CEDAR precedent in characters/exchange_student.md. Astronomy/Unix expertise + minestrone folded in from a follow-up founder note. Commit cb80a63.

title: New supporting character: The Auditor (Uncompromised guild founder)
